title: wslua: Improve __tostring for all classes
description:
``` Five wslua classes had no __tostring metamethod, so `print(x)` and the debugger's Variables view fell back to Lua's default `Class: 0x`. Add concise, single-line previews for each one, following a shared convention: - `Class:` prefix with a single colon. - `key=value` pairs for parameters (unquoted for numbers/enums). - Degenerate state as a parenthesised tag after the colon, e.g. `Class: (expired)`, `(closed)`, `(null)`. Per-class rendering: Dumper Dumper: file_type= encap= when open; Dumper: (closed) once Dumper:close() has run. Reuses the wtap helpers that already back the file_type_name and encap_name attributes, and bypasses checkDumper so a closed dumper stays inspectable. Dir Dir: path= while open; appends `(closed)` once Dir:close() has run. The path used by Dir.open() is now stored on the Dir struct (new `path` field) so the label survives the directory walk; ownership of the cleaned-up name moves from the local in Dir.open() into the struct and is released in Dir__gc. Pref Pref: type= value=, using the existing pref_type_to_string helper for and a small value-preview helper for . Unregistered prefs (created with Pref.bool() etc. but not yet assigned into a Prefs table) show `Pref: (unregistered) type= value=`. Prefs Prefs: entries=, where is the owning protocol's short name and walks the Pref linked list anchored at prefs_p->next. GcryptCipher GcryptCipher: (open) while the handle is live, GcryptCipher: (closed) once it has been garbage- collected. Libgcrypt does not expose algorithm or mode metadata back from a gcry_cipher_hd_t, so the label stops at the open/closed state. Four wslua classes had __tostring metamethods that did not actually identify the underlying object: `a Pinfo` and `Columns` were bare placeholder strings, `Conversation` leaked a raw pointer, and PrivateTable rendered a bare comma-separated key list with no class prefix (so the value was indistinguishable from a regular string in the debugger Variables view). Replace them with concise, single-line previews following a shared convention: - `Class:` prefix with a single colon. - `key=value` pairs for parameters; free-text values quoted with `"..."`. - Degenerate state as a parenthesised tag after the colon, e.g. `Class: (expired)`, `(null)`, `(no cinfo)`. Per-class rendering: Pinfo Pinfo: frame= src= dst= proto=

len=, with Pinfo: (expired) for an expired handle. Bypasses checkPinfo (which raises on null/expired) so the debugger can still render an expired Pinfo hovered in the Variables view instead of erroring. Columns Columns: number="1" protocol="TCP" info="...", limited to the three columns most useful for a quick "what packet is this" glance - pairs(cols) still walks the full set. Columns: (no cinfo) is returned when cinfo is NULL (e.g. while dissecting for the details pane), matching the existing note on Column.__tostring. Conversation Conversation: id= src=: dst=: type=, built by walking conv->key_ptr to pick up addresses, ports and conv-type. Endpoints are labelled src/dst to match Pinfo's rendering, even though Conversation itself is directionless; addr1/addr2 follow the order in the underlying key. Ports are omitted when zero (matching the wildcard options exposed by Conversation.find), and the convtype is the trailing component of the matching convtypes.* enum (TCP, UDP, ...). A new convtype_to_short_str helper does the lookup against the existing convtype_enums table. PrivateTable PrivateTable: keys={k1, k2, k3} with PrivateTable: (expired) for a stale handle. Same underlying GHashTable walk as before; just rebuilt to use the standard Class: ... shape. Fourteen wslua classes had __tostring metamethods that dumped raw numeric ids, leaked internal pointers, returned the object's full text content, or otherwise duplicated information already exposed as attributes. Replace them with concise, single-line previews following a shared convention: - `Class:` prefix with a single colon. - `key=value` pairs for parameters; free-text values quoted with `"..."`. - Degenerate state as a parenthesised tag after the colon, e.g. `Class: (expired)`, `(null)`, `(root)`, `(no item)`, `(Decode As only)`. Per-class rendering: Tvb Tvb: captured= reported= bytes=, using tvb_bytes_to_str for the truncated hex preview. TvbRange TvbRange: offset= length= bytes=, with TvbRange: offset= length=0 (empty) for zero-length ranges. Expired-tvb handling is unchanged. ProtoField ProtoField: type= base= name="" and appends mask=0x when a non-zero mask is set. Fixes a %p value-string pointer leak and drops the full description blob (still reachable via the description/vs attributes). hfid stays on the hfid attribute rather than in the label. ProtoExpert ProtoExpert: severity= text="", resolving severity via val_to_str_const against expert_severity_vals (matches the ProtoExpert.severity attribute). ProtoExpert: (null) for a null handle. TreeItem TreeItem: for an attached field, TreeItem: (root) for a text-only/root tree, and TreeItem: (expired) / (no item) / (null) for the degenerate cases. Replaces the previous expired/item/tree/same boolean-flag dump. DissectorTable DissectorTable: type= and appends base= for integer tables or (Decode As only) for FT_NONE tables. Drops the trailing colon + embedded newline from the old form. CaptureInfo/ CaptureInfo[Const]: file_type= CaptureInfoConst encap= snaplen=, or (expired) once the underlying wtap/wtap_dumper is gone. Symbolic names via wtap_file_type_subtype_name and wtap_encap_name, not raw numeric ids. FrameInfo/ FrameInfo[Const]: encap= caplen= FrameInfoConst len=, or (expired). Drops the raw rec_type/presence_flags/pkt_encap dump and leaked wtap_block_t pointer of the old form. File File: mode= where is reader or writer, with `(expired)` appended once the FileHandler callback that produced it has returned. File: (null) for a null handle. FileHandler FileHandler: caps=[] description="" where / is r/w when the handler can read/write and `-` otherwise (e.g. [rw], [r-], [-w]). Replaces the old Lua registry refs dump. Listener Listener: filter= tapinfo=. filter=none when no display filter was supplied; tapinfo reflects whether a per-packet tapinfo extractor is registered. ProgDlg ProgDlg: title="" task="<task>" state=<state> where <state> is running or stopped. Fixes the previous `stopped` / `not stopped` bare rendering that was indistinguishable from a regular string. Proto Proto: <loname> description="<desc>". loname is the short/filter name used in DissectorTables and display filters; desc is the long description string from `Proto.new` (the implementation incorrectly used the short name here; fixed to use `proto->desc`). PseudoHeader PseudoHeader: type=<type> (brought into the shared key=value shape; previous form was PseudoHeader (<type>), which matched nothing else). TextWindow TextWindow: title="<title>" state=<state> where <state> is open or closed. The previous __tostring was wired to TextWindow:get_text() and returned the window's full text contents, which made the value indistinguishable from a regular string in the debugger Variables view. The title is now stored on the TextWindow struct so the label survives the constructor, and the full text is still reachable via TextWindow:get_text() for callers that need it. ```
